result_lines: PASS: 45 Markdown files, 57 JSON files, current documents, 476 local links including headings, fences and strict JSON
PASS: standard Go CRC32C, header/frame offsets, dedup section, create DAT lengths and sample expiry
PASS: pack offsets/CRC/SHA, raw+gzip blocks, compressed audit, 5 DAT ranges, current/prefix stability through seq=4, 4 invalid gzip samples
PASS: control frame/snapshot/current bytes, CRC/SHA, JSON equality, 4 invalid control examples
PASS: 26 HTTP decision examples (not a live HTTP server)
PASS: independent HMAC ID/token vector, token tamper, 3 six-calendar-month boundaries
PASS: design checks only; application, crash, device and load tests NOT RUN

limitations: CPU scaling is not established from the baseline observed ratio > 1.6 because two baseline 2CPU trials had major I/O stalls.
The overlap prototype could not reproduce an SSD throughput improvement and had worse sustained latency; it was rejected.
tmpfs provides no durable-storage or power-loss proof.

After restart, optional queue counts describe only the last boot; both sustained trials show 17 failed optional records. Do not claim optional logs were lossless or infer a regression from those counters alone.
Two overlap trials contain Web POST HTTP 429 rejections after catch-up; keep them as failures and do not treat their durations as equal successful work.
No candidate is deployed; the 17 verified candidate source files were restored to HEAD after their exact source was archived.
